patterns: Most frequent shape: philosophy -> founder (Vishishtadvaita = Ramanuja, Shuddhadvaita = Vallabha, Advaita = Shankara; Pushtimarga = Vallabha in APPSC G1).
Chronology items (Shankara - Ramanuja - Chaitanya) and 'first to preach in Hindi' = Ramananda recur across PSCs.
Ramananda: Kabir as disciple and the dictum 'Let no man ask a man's sect or caste'.
APPSC Andhra angle: Ramanuja's movement in Andhra = Bhakti movement; Statue of Equality in Hyderabad (UPSC 2022).
'Not correct' statement items as trap (Madhva did not preach Nirguna); app adds deep book/centre/Vyasa Tirtha detail beyond PYQ depth.
